snippet.title: TRS-80 CoCo Game:  Dino wars (1980 R.G. Kilgus) (Coco Ver 2)
snippet.description:
Before Neo Geo's King of the Monsters, this is an arcade-style fighting game where you control two dinosaurs battling against each other using joystick. You try to position the dino you control in front or behind the other for a quick roaring bite attack for a knock down, reducing the score of the other player's dino by 20 points. The playfield goes from left to right but also has some depth of field both near and far. This allows for dodging to avoid your opponent's parallel attack. Once you have successfully reduced your opponent's score to zero, you win the game and your opponent's dino will run off into distance yelping due to his wounds.

Played and recorded on messui 0.216.

Note: Not sure what is causing the controls to control both dinos at the same time.
